sources.name: Claude-Flow — AI Orchestration
sources.description: Enterprise AI orchestration with hive-mind swarm intelligence, 87 MCP tools, 84.8% SWE-Bench solve rate. Queen-led AI coordination, WASM-accelerated neural models.

sources.name: Awesome Claude Skills Directory
sources.description: Free curated directory of Claude skills. Install by adding SKILL.md to .claude/skills/<name>/. Skills load on-demand unlike CLAUDE.md.

sources.name: Claude AI Skills Collection 2026
sources.description: Curated collection of official Anthropic + community Claude skills: docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx, revealjs, EPUB, research, testing, and more.

sources.name: Open Source Projects Discovery
sources.description: Curated open-source project discovery — hidden gems, trending repos, developer tools. A broadsheet for software that does not ask for your email.

sources.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
sources.description: Self-improving AI agent with built-in learning loop — creates skills from experience, autonomous memory, cron scheduler, Telegram/Discord/Slack gateway, subagents, 6 terminal backends. Compatible with agentskills.io standard.

sources.name: scroll-world — Fly-Through Landing Page Skill
sources.description: Agent skill (SKILL.md) that builds immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing pages — camera flies through scenes as you scroll, Apple-style. Works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, 20+ agents. Framework-agnostic vanilla JS scrub engine.

sources.name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
sources.description: 161 reasoning rules + 84 UI styles for world-class UI/UX design. Agent skill (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Covers layouts, typography, color, accessibility, animations, and design systems.

sources.name: PocketBase — Open Source Backend in 1 File
sources.description: Open source Go backend: embedded SQLite with realtime subscriptions, file/users management, Admin dashboard UI, REST-ish API. Single portable executable. Perfect for rapid prototyping and small-medium projects.

sources.name: Claude Marketplaces Directory
sources.description: Curated directory of Claude Code skills, plugin marketplaces, MCP servers, commands, hooks, and agents. Install anything with a single command. Ranked by install count, GitHub stars, and community votes.

sources.name: find-skills (Vercel Labs)
sources.description: Skill that helps discover and install agent skills from the open ecosystem. Searches skills.sh leaderboard, runs npx skills find, recommends quality-verified skills.

sources.name: claude-mem — Persistent Shared Memory
sources.description: Persistent memory compression for Claude Code. Auto-captures tool usage, generates semantic summaries, makes context available across sessions. Web viewer UI, privacy controls with <private> tags, natural language mem-search.

sources.name: frontend-design (Anthropic Official)
sources.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design. Design-lead mindset: opinionated palette, typography, layout choices specific to each brief. Anti-template approach. Includes RTL/Arabic considerations.

sources.name: extract-design-system
sources.description: Reverse-engineer design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, border radius, shadows) from any public website. Outputs W3C-compatible tokens.json + tokens.css. Agent skill for Claude, Cursor, Codex.

sources.name: Superpowers — Full AI Development Methodology
sources.description: Complete software development methodology for coding agents. Spec extraction, subagent-driven TDD, YAGNI/DRY enforcement, autonomous multi-hour execution. Works with Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and more.

sources.name: Page Agent (Alibaba) — GUI Agent for Web Pages
sources.description: One script gives any web page its own AI agent. GUI agent that lives in your webpage — automates UI interactions, form filling, navigation, and page tasks. Chrome extension available. By Alibaba.

sources.name: Strix — AI Autonomous Penetration Testing
sources.description: Autonomous AI pentesters that act like real hackers — run code dynamically, find vulnerabilities, validate with working PoCs. Multi-agent orchestration, CI/CD integration, auto-fix PRs, compliance reports. Requires Docker + LLM API key.

sources.name: Career Helper — End-to-End Career Support
sources.description: 14 skills: personal career coach (Tim), CV/ATS rewriting, LinkedIn optimisation, interview prep, job scout, skills radar, career transitions, AI impact assessment, employer footprint, kanban job tracker, NED AI governance, personal brand. Available on all Claude plans including free.
sources.install_command: claude plugin marketplace add Zal4DW/career-helper && claude plugin install career-helper@career-helper
sources.install_desktop: Claude Desktop → + → Add plugins → Add marketplace from GitHub → Zal4DW/career-helper

sources.name: Career-Ops — Multi-Agent Job Search System
sources.description: Multi-agent AI job search system featured in WIRED + Business Insider. 740+ job listings evaluated, 100+ personalised CVs. Companies use AI to filter candidates — this gives candidates AI to choose companies.

sources.name: Awesome Claude Design (rohitg00)
sources.description: Curated DESIGN.md files grouped by aesthetic family, remix recipes, prompt packs with example outputs, skills, video teardowns. For Claude Design (Anthropic Labs AI design workspace).

sources.name: Awesome Claude Design (VoltAgent) — DESIGN.md Collection
sources.description: Ready-to-use DESIGN.md files — upload to Claude Design, get a full design system (colors, type, components, preview cards, UI kit) in one shot. Powered by getdesign.md.

sources.name: HackingTool — All-in-One Hacking Toolkit (185+ tools)
sources.description: 185+ curated pentesting + ethical hacking tools across 35 categories: info gathering, web vuln scanning, network scanning, active directory, cloud security, mobile security, post-exploitation, reverse engineering. OS-aware menus, tag filter, search, Docker support.

sources.name: Impeccable — Design Guidance for AI Coding Agents
sources.description: Design skill for Claude: 1 skill, 23 commands (/polish, /audit, /critique, /animate, /bolder, /quieter...), 46 deterministic detector rules. Writes PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md. Live browser iteration. Eliminates AI design tells (Inter-for-everything, purple gradients, cards-in-cards). Built on Anthropic frontend-design skill.

sources.name: Frontend Design — Official Claude Plugin (Anthropic)
sources.description: Official Anthropic Claude plugin. Generates distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces: bold aesthetic choices (brutalist, maximalist, retro-futuristic, luxury, playful), unexpected typography pairings, orchestrated motion, asymmetric composition, gradients/textures/depth. Avoids generic AI tells. Activates automatically when you ask Claude to build UIs.
sources.activation: Automatic — just ask Claude to build a frontend interface

sources.name: Playwright — End-to-End Testing Framework (Microsoft)
sources.description: Microsoft end-to-end testing for React/Next.js/TypeScript. Chromium, Firefox, WebKit. Auto-wait, codegen (record tests), API testing, visual comparisons, trace viewer, parallel execution, CI/CD integration. The standard E2E testing tool for modern web apps.

sources.name: OpenRouter — Unified API for 300+ AI Models (Free + Paid)
sources.description: One API, one bill, one auth for 300+ LLMs. Free models available (Llama, Mistral, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, etc.). Chat, image generation, embeddings, transcription. OpenAI-compatible API. Browse free models at openrouter.ai/models?supported_parameters=free

sources.name: Meetily — Privacy-First AI Meeting Assistant (Local)
sources.description: Local AI meeting transcription + summaries. Runs entirely on your machine — no cloud, no data leakage. Real-time transcription via Whisper (supports Arabic + multilingual). Summaries via Ollama (local), Claude, Groq, or OpenRouter. macOS/Windows/Linux. Perfect for GhostForge enterprise/government client meetings.
